explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.default: Credit-card ledger balances and manual liabilities both count in net worth, including dated history. Enter only a separate obligation here; recording the card obligation again counts it twice. Equal amounts are a warning, not proof of a duplicate. Archiving an account or pausing a forecast does not erase debt.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.default: Interpretations differ on asset eligibility, debt deductions, gold or silver Nisab, and whether wealth stays above the threshold throughout Hawl or at its boundaries. Lunar and solar periods may use different annual rates. Choose and cite your method, rate and calendar explicitly; Farz does not select a religious authority or convert one method into another. Review the included and excluded items and consult your chosen qualified adviser where needed.
